note: Small live snapshot pulled through a browser on 2026-10-10 between 21:15 and 21:25 UTC, so the project has real data before scripts/fetch-data.mjs is run. Values are verbatim from the sources; only the file format was normalised (Kp and SOCRATES rows converted to CSV).

celestrak-stations.csv.credit: CelesTrak GP data (18 SDS via Space-Track)
celestrak-stations.csv.notes: ISS and CSS modules and docked vehicles share one element set, so they propagate to the same point. Five objects already carry 6-digit catalog numbers (100057, 100712, 100882) that the TLE format cannot represent.

noaa-kp-3h.csv.notes: Geomagnetic storm in progress at snapshot time: Kp 7 at 15-18 UTC and 6.67 at 18-21 UTC on 2026-10-10.

socrates-top10-maxprob.csv.url: https://celestrak.org/SOCRATES/ (Top 10 Conjunctions by Maximum Probability table)
socrates-top10-maxprob.csv.notes: max_probability is a conservative upper bound from public GP data, not an operator Pc. Rows 6-10 (ISS ZVEZDA vs SOYUZ-MS 29) are a docked pair, not a real threat: filter pairs whose rel_speed is ~0 km/s. Row 1 (STARLINK-4429 vs COSMOS 2251 DEB, 7 m at 13.95 km/s on 2026-10-13) is the genuine headline.
